name: 83646 · Meridian, ID
findings: ZIP 83646 (Meridian) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 42 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 83646 (Meridian) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 83646 (Meridian) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
